defects.what: Standoff pitch is wrong for V3's board: 76.0 x 36.0 instead of 75.0 x 35.0. Cause in the data: parts/perfboard/part.json params.hole_inset default 2.0 (E1-01 photo value) was used; V3's grading delta puts the holes 2.5 in from each edge. The V3 request text does not state the inset, so this may be a catalogue/request data gap rather than agent logic (see the observation for Robin).

summary: DOES NOT MEET (class MINOR: all gates G0-G5 pass, but weight-3 L3.3.1.3, L3.3.1.4 and L3.12.1.2 fail). Weighted score 125/135 = 0.926; worst weight-3 normalised margin -2.9 (L3.3.1.3). One root cause: Standoffs and their M2 pilots are on the agent's catalogue hole pattern (inset 2.0 -> 76.0 x 36.0), not V3's graded pattern (holes at (2.5,2.5),(77.5,2.5),(2.5,37.5),(77.5,37.5), pitch 75.0 x 35.0). Everything else measured independently passes: board clearance 1.59, keep-outs 0.18/0.10, USB plug 0.40, jack plug 0.40, walls/floor/lid 2.4, lip gap 0.25 and engagement 2.1, envelope 94.2x54.2x35.7, no overhangs beyond exempt ones, 1 shell per body. Observations (do not change the verdict): (1) For Robin: the V3 request text does not state the hole inset (2.5) or diameter (3.0); the perfboard part.json defaults (2.0 / dia 2.0) come from the E1-01 photo, so the agent could not derive 2.5 from its inputs. Graded as written. (2) The corner bosses (axis (-3.787,-3.787), OD 6.6) poke 0.15 mm into each inner cavity corner; harmless. (3) layout.json 'grid_residual': 2.75 contradicts the agent's own grid_conformance 0.00; judge measures 0.00. (4) The renders and STLs are in V3_s0/20261024-174332/, not V3_s0/views. (5) claude-context MCP was unavailable (it failed to connect); only known paths were read and no repo search was needed.
